machine_learning_models.name: conventional autoencoding (CAE)
machine_learning_models.task: automatically extract features from molten pool images and identify anomalies during the LPBF process
machine_learning_models.target: anomaly identification (normal vs anomalous molten pools)

evidence.quote: Their method enabled the model to automatically detect and label “ anomalous ” molten pools, achieving an accuracy of 95 % and an F1 score of 82 % in distinguishing between normal and anomalous molten pools in the LPBF process of the In625 alloy.
